source: CDC WONDER Underlying Cause of Death, 1999-2020

contents.source_export_selection_note: The user reports selecting all ages and all available years. The exported query-parameter block does not serialize age, sex, cause, or year selections, so those filters cannot be independently reconstructed from this file alone.

integration_status: raw validation context only; incompatible with the current all_cause_mortality_annual baseline until a reproducible export is made for male, age 45-54, years 2015-2019, with county deaths and population pooled over that window.
suppression_note: Do not derive or publish suppressed small-cell counts.
